name: Wire Capability On Agent Write
description: After the agent writes a skill or guardrail file, runs the wiring validator. Silent when the file is already fully wired.

then.prompt: If the file just written is under skills/ or context/guardrails/, run python3 context/scripts/validate-wiring.py --strict and complete any missing attachment points per sops/wire-new-capability.sop.md. If validation passes clean, say nothing.
